options.name: api_key
options.description: UptimeRobot API key. See C(uptimerobot_monitor) for the resolution order.

options.name: api_key_file
options.description: Path to a file whose first line is the UptimeRobot API key. Tilde-expanded.

options.name: friendly_name
options.description: Filter the returned list to the monitor whose C(friendly_name) is an exact match for this value. The result is still a list (length 0 or 1) for shape stability. Applied client-side after I(search) has narrowed the API response.

options.name: search
options.description: Server-side, case-insensitive substring filter forwarded to UptimeRobot's C(search) parameter. Useful to keep the response small when the account has thousands of monitors. Combine with I(friendly_name) to narrow further.
